vetSays.line: 🛡️ Sandra, Pablo, Sebastián and Jesse met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Sandra, Pablo, Sebastián, Jesse are hurt.
🛡️ Sandra, Heidi, Pablo and Jesse met them at the door — 4 put down. Heidi, Pablo, Jesse are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. A Elder veteran.
The Elder Glasswing Darter falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Elder Glasswing Darter!
📺 You brought down Elder Glasswing Darter. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Elder Glasswing Darter.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Heidi, Sam, Ruby, James and Nora met them at the door — 5 put down. Heidi, Sam, Ruby, Nora are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Nora strikes the Scarred Grief Counselor.
Sandra strikes the Scarred Grief Counselor.
Nora strikes the Scarred Grief Counselor.
Sandra strikes the Scarred Grief Counselor.
Nora strikes the Scarred Grief Counselor.
The Scarred Grief Counselor falls.
📺 Sandra brought down Scarred Grief Counselor. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Sandra brought down Scarred Grief Counselor. Together.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruby just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Heidi, Sebastián, Jesse, James and Dmitri met them at the door — 5 put down. Heidi, Sebastián, Jesse, James, Dmitri are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruby just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? James just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Pablo, Sebastián, Jesse, Ruby and James met them at the door — 5 put down. Pablo, Sebastián, Jesse, Ruby, James are hurt.
